kwargs.content: {"summary":"From 14:21 UTC on 2026-03-22 the search service had p99 query latency about 6x baseline (about 150 ms rising to 1100 ms) and query timeouts at the 5000 ms limit. The cause was disk I/O saturation from the nightly reindex job, which was rebuilding 12 shards in parallel. Pausing reindex-job-nightly brought disk I/O and latency back to baseline by 15:15 UTC.
